name: sound
purpose: Play one sound on request: a sample-free strike, which is an approximation, or a technique of an embedded profile with its facts, sources, recorded sample and media.
keys: W plays when the Play button has focus; E loads a YouTube clip when Load video has focus; Q turns Loop on or off when Loop has focus; Enter or Space clicks the button

voice.doc: A strike object only: kind="strike", frequency 20–8000 Hz, decay 0.01–5 seconds, gain 0–1, partials (1–8 objects with ratio 0.0025–400 and gain 0–1), optional noise 0–1 and bend -1200–1200 cents. Each partial, including its bent frequency, must stay at 20–8000 Hz. No URLs, samples, code or other fields. tone is reserved, not supported.

play.doc: {profile: an alias in profiles, technique: a technique id of that profile}. The block shows the technique facts and source links. A technique voice is a strike or {kind: "sample", media: an audio record id}; a sample plays only on Play. While the block shows, it also shows the technique media with a credit line for each: images, local video with a Loop button, and a YouTube clip that loads only when the learner clicks Load video. Before its after gate opens, no media is in the page. A technique with no voice has no sound, so Play stays disabled.

ref.doc: Optional link only: {url: an https or http lesson or recording URL, title: its name}. Shown as Hear it played; never loaded as audio.
